h:
SDXL / Illustrious / Pony 的测试工作流程。

这是我的 Epoch 测试工作流程。

一次最多 12 个 epoch。还可用于在单个提示和/或 Loras 上测试多个检查点。您可以使用很多组合。

这是一个非常简单的工作流程，只有两个子图，一个用于模型/剪辑负载，另一个用于采样。每个纪元都有可选择的模型。

我试图将自定义节点保持在最低限度，据我所知，Lora Manage 和所有/无处不在是此工作流程的唯一扩展。

您可能希望在保存节点上关闭“保存元数据”。发生的情况是，测试中使用的每个 lora 都会保存到一批中的所有图像中。

o.en:
Testing workflow for SDXL / Illustrious / Pony.

This my Epoch Testing Workflow.

Up to 12 epochs at a time. Can also be used to test multiple Checkpoints on a single Prompt and or Loras. There are a lot of combos you can use.

This is a pretty straight forward work flow, only two sub-graphs, one for Model / Clip load, the other is sampling. Each Epoch has select-able Model.

I tried to keep Custom nodes to a Minimum, to the best of my Knowledge Lora Manage and everything / everywhere are the only extensions on this workflow.

You may want to keep Save meta-data off at the save nodes. what Happens is each lora used in testing would get saved to all the images in a batch.
